summary.text: Chris Lewis is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 29 who took office on January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Cassie Blausey.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had dedicated his career to public service at the Louisville Metro Council.

paragraphs.text: Chris Lewis was born in Louisville, Kentucky, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisville in 2002.
Lewis succeeded Republican Kevin Bratcher in District 29.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House State Government, House Local Government and Small Business & Information Technology committees.
In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a conservative Christian, said he is pro-life and a supporter of the Second Amendment, and said public safety is his top concern.
